note: Datetime Extras adds field-plugin surface only: a time_only_field field type (widget+formatter time_only_field_default), datetime widgets datetime_datelist_no_time and datatime_configurable (plus deprecated datatime_extras_configurable_list), and a daterange_duration widget (needs duration_field). No configure route, permissions, services, or Drush. All state is field storage/widget/formatter settings in field + entity_form_display/entity_view_display config. Introspection reads back a widget set on a real datetime field; execution creates a time_only_field field verified via FieldStorageConfig::getType().

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with datetime_extras, I want a core Date-only editing experience: an editor should pick a date from select lists with NO time input on a core datetime field. Which field widget provided by datetime_extras do I choose, and what is its plugin id?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'Select list, no time' widget, plugin id datetime_datelist_no_time, on the datetime field in Manage form display. Core only offers a datelist WITH time; this widget renders the date-part select lists with no time element.

evals.prompt: I need to store just a time of day (like a shop opening time) with no date on a Drupal entity. Does datetime_extras provide a field type for that, and what is its id?
evals.expected_output: Yes: datetime_extras adds the 'Time only field' field type, id time_only_field (extends core DateTimeItem with datetime_type 'time'). Its default widget and formatter are both time_only_field_default.

evals.prompt: With datetime_extras, how can an editor enter a datetime_range value as a start plus a duration instead of an explicit end, and what extra module must be enabled for that widget to appear?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'Date and time range with duration' widget (id daterange_duration) on a core daterange field; it lets editors set a start then an absolute end OR a relative duration. It requires the contrib duration_field module (>= 8.x-2.0-rc3) — datetime_extras hides the widget via hook_field_widget_info_alter() until duration_field is enabled.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Date/time field named field_dte_when. Inspect the live default form display and state which field widget (plugin id) is configured for that field.
evals.expected_output: field_dte_when uses the datetime_extras widget datetime_datelist_no_time ('Select list, no time'). Discoverable via `drush cget core.entity_form_display.node.article.default content.field_dte_when` (type: datetime_datelist_no_time).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_dte_when uses a datetime_extras 'Select list, no time' widget. Inspect the live default form display and report the configured date part order (the date_order widget setting) for that field.
evals.expected_output: field_dte_when's datetime_datelist_no_time widget has settings.date_order = 'YMD'. Discoverable via `drush cget core.entity_form_display.node.article.default content.field_dte_when` (settings.date_order: YMD).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the datetime_extras module to add a field named field_dte_time to the Article content type that stores ONLY a time of day (no date). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Article has a field field_dte_time whose field storage type is time_only_field (the datetime_extras 'Time only field' field type), e.g. FieldStorageConfig::create(['field_name'=>'field_dte_time','entity_type'=>'node','type'=>'time_only_field','settings'=>['datetime_type'=>'time']])->save() then a matching FieldConfig on article.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article type has a Date/time field field_dte_setw. Configure its editing form so authors pick the value from date select-list dropdowns with no time input, using datetime_extras. Save the change on the live site.
evals.expected_output: The reset creates field_dte_setw as a core datetime field with the core datetime_default widget; the agent must set the node.article default form-display widget for field_dte_setw to datetime_datelist_no_time ('Select list, no time') and save.
